prompt_text: What is the best tool for an Airbnb host to set nightly pricing and analyze a market before buying?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- For market research before buying: AirDNA (MarketMinder / Rentalizer) is the best single tool for most hosts.
- For setting nightly pricing on a live listing: PriceLabs or Wheelhouse are the most popular/flexible; Beyond Pricing is another solid option.

Recommended combo for most buyers
- Use AirDNA to analyze a neighborhood, estimate occupancy, ADR and revenue potential before you buy.
- Once you own the listing, use PriceLabs (or Wheelhouse) to run dynamic nightly pricing synced to your Airbnb calendar.

Why that combo
- AirDNA: designed specifically for short‑term rental investment decisions. It shows historical occupancy, daily rates, seasonality, comparable listings, RevPAR and supply growth, and has a “Rentalizer” revenue estimator for an address.
- PriceLabs: excellent customization (minimum stay rules, day‑of‑week adjustments, custom seasonality), strong automation, and broad PMS/airbnb integration. Wheelhouse offers similar features with a more opinionated, optimization‑focused approach. Beyond Pricing is simpler to set up but less customizable.

Other useful tools (when to pick them)
- Mashvisor: quick ROI and cashflow estimates aimed at real‑estate investors; good as a second opinion.
- Transparent / AllTheRooms / STR-data providers: deeper market intelligence for power users or managers with many units.
- InsideAirbnb: free scraping tool for granular listing-level data (helpful to validate market supply and types of listings).
- Zillow/Redfin + local comps: to check property prices, taxes, insurance, and trends — essential for financial modeling.
- PMSs / channel managers (Hostaway, Guesty): if you plan multi‑channel distribution and to integrate pricing tools.

Things to check beyond software
- Local regulations and allowed use (some cities heavily restrict STRs).
- Seasonality and major events.
- Cleaning, utilities, furnishing, insurance, property management costs.
- Mortgage, tax and occupancy tax rules.
- Supply growth (new hotels / new STRs) which can depress future rates.

Budget & trials
- AirDNA: paid (monthly or annual). Rentalizer runs per property or unlimited with MarketMinder.
- PriceLabs: monthly per listing with free trial.
- Wheelhouse / Beyond Pricing: similar monthly per‑listing pricing and trials.
- Mashvisor/Transparent: paid tiers.

If you want, tell me the city/neighborhood you’re considering and I can:
- run a quick list of comparable Airbnb metrics to show ADR/occupancy ranges, or
- recommend which tool (and tier) fits your budget and scale.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
